name: voice_memos
description: Mac-native Voice Memos auto-watch + plain Whisper transcription. Community tier. For speaker diarization, calendar stitching, and meeting summaries, see the Pro-tier plugins/meeting_capture plugin.

VOICE_MEMOS_DIR.description: Path to the Voice Memos recordings directory. Default is the macOS Voice Memos.app location.

VOICE_MEMOS_OPT_IN.description: Auto-watch is opt-in (off by default) because surprise audio ingestion is creepy. Set via Cerid setup wizard.

WHISPER_MODEL.description: Same model as the Pro plugin; setting this independently lets users pick faster/smaller for plain transcription if desired.
